title: A Nomad's Tale | NORMAL
description: Your first step to become a Nomad in Minecraft.
body:
## Download A Nomad's Tale | LITE [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/a-nomads-tale-lite)
# **Welcome, Traveler!**

Are you fellas looking for a modpack to **change the way you play** Minecraft? Here's a good one for you! **A Nomad's Tale | NORMAL** is the default version of the modpack i'm creating, combining **50 mods** (excluding optimization mods and libraries) for everyone searching for the perfect AND full of content **Nomadic Lifestyle** experience!

![A Nomad's Tale](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b2ff1fa97e1dd55d171a19de31d4da83ff175a7.png)

## NORMAL vs LITE
There are **TWO** versions of **A Nomad's Tale**, here's a comparison table between both versions
(NORMAL = 50 Mods/2 Resource Packs/8 Shaders, LITE = 20 Mods)
![Comparison table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1957fd007618d200c343ae7689cd6185230f73bd.jpeg)

## Why does this modpack exist?
I made this modpack because i want to create a **nomadic modpack** with LOTS of new discoveries for everyone to enjoy! (including me). With all the **50 mods** united, this modpack adds TONS of new content, where some examples can be seen in the **[modpack's gallery](https://modrinth.com/modpack/a-nomads-tale/gallery)** (All images are taken using Complementary: Reimagined/Bliss/Solas Shaders and Freecam Mod).

Here's a short list of what you'll have in the modpack:
- **NEW BIOMES**
  
  Let's go sightseeing! Where? **EVERYWHERE**! In this modpack, you'll see a ton of biomes worth exploring, and they're all built without any new blocks! You may also see some subtle or obvious paths in some biomes that can lead to structures.
  
- **CAMPING**
  
  Being a **Nomad** means you'll be moving from time to time, which means you need a temporary home like **tents**! Other than that, you can also craft **sleeping bags** that require less materials compared to a bed, and **backpacks** you can carry around! No more headaches like having to break a chest to move around.
  
- **OCEAN EXPLORATION**
  
  Get on your boat, traveler! Cause we're heading to the sea! There are a few mods here that makes the ocean worth exploring other than just ocean ruins & monuments, such as **Lily Pad Villages** and **Antique Trading Ships**!

- **NORMAL EDITION ONLY**
  
  **Overhauled Ruins, Temples, Ocean Monuments, Villages & Caves**! Alongside **The Nether**, now with **double the height and new structures**! **The End** also has a **complete makeover**, and.. did i just hear something from the **Ancient City**? Hmm, must've been the wind.
![???](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86f7cc83eb73ac304cf669831be9125b5478dee0.png)

## What are you waiting for?

Download the modpack right now, and **craft your own Tale as a Nomad!**
(Credits go to each of the respective and awesome mod creators that made this modpack possible)
